tools.name: list_project_dashboards
tools.title: List project dashboards with pagination
tools.description: Get paginated dashboards for a project by ID, using 'limit' and 'offset'. Must authenticate with PersonalAPIKeyAuth. Includes count, pagination, and dashboard details.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.
offset.title: Offset

project_id.description: Project ID of the project you"re trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
project_id.title: Project Id

tools.name: get_feature_flags_matching_ids
tools.title: Get feature flags matching IDs
tools.description: Tool to get IDs of all feature flags matching the current filters. Uses the same filtering logic as the list endpoint and returns only IDs that the user has permission to edit.

project_id.description: Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
project_id.title: Project Id
